# SaaS Boilerplate

> Production-ready Next.js boilerplate for building SaaS applications.

## What is this?

SaaS Boilerplate is a full-stack starter template for building Software-as-a-Service applications. It includes authentication, billing, multi-tenancy, and all the essential features you need to launch a SaaS product quickly.

## Key Features

- Authentication with email/password, social login, and MFA
- Stripe billing with subscription management
- Multi-tenant organizations with role-based access control
- Internationalization (English and French)
- Email notifications with React Email templates
- File upload system
- Admin panel
- Dark/light theme support

## Tech Stack

- Next.js (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
- Better Auth (self-hosted authentication)
- Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL
- Stripe
- React Email + Nodemailer

## Getting Started

Visit the documentation for setup instructions and guides.
